questions.q: What does a 'Prospective' business relationship allow a supplier to do?
options: Participate in sourcing and qualification activity, but not yet be paid
Receive payments immediately
Automatically become Spend Authorized after 30 days
Merge with another supplier
questions.explain: Prospective suppliers can participate in negotiations and qualification but cannot yet transact or be paid.

questions.q: What does 'Spend Authorized' mean for a supplier?
options: The supplier is only allowed to respond to RFQs
The supplier is cleared for actual transactions like purchase orders and invoices
The supplier's bank account has been merged
The supplier is pending business classification review
questions.explain: Spend Authorized suppliers are cleared to transact — purchase orders and invoices can be created against them.

questions.q: In the Create Supplier flow, what is the relationship between addresses and sites?
options: They are unrelated; sites don't use addresses
An address can only be used by one site ever
A site is built by selecting a previously created address and giving the site its own unique name
Sites must be created before any address exists
questions.explain: Addresses are created first; a site is then created by picking one of those addresses, which is why one address can back more than one site.

questions.q: Where does a supplier's bank account get attached during profile setup?
options: The Organization tab
The Products and Services tab
The Transaction Tax tab
The Payments tab
questions.explain: Bank account details for a supplier are set up under the Payments area of the supplier profile.

questions.q: Why might a newly created supplier end up unable to be paid on its first invoice?
options: Because new suppliers can never be paid in Fusion
Because the record was saved with an incomplete profile, such as a missing site assignment or bank account
Because the supplier name contains a number
Because the invoice was dated too early
questions.explain: A supplier record can be saved before all tabs are filled in — which is exactly how gaps like a missing bank account or site assignment surface later.
